senses.gloss: (b. h. חָדָה, cmp. חדר)to be bright, glad; to rejoice.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:63">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 63</cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <cite ref="H00190"><he>חַדֵּי</he></cite>, incorr.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 122:1">Targ. Ps. CXXII, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 68b:13">Pes. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲדָאִי נפשאי</he> (Ms. M. <he>נפש</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) be glad, my soul!—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:17">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 10b:25">Meg. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>מי ח׳ קודשא וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) does the Lord rejoice in the downfall &c.?; a. e. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:6:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top, v. next w.]

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 30:2">Targ. Ps. XXX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:28">Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 28</cite> <he>ויַחֲדוּן</he>, fr. <cite ref="A00996"><he>אֲחד</he></cite>.]—Y. Snh. l. c., v. infra.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 21:7">Targ. Ps. XXI, 7</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. l. c. <he>ומְחַדְּיֵי לכין</he> who will entertain you (Y. Snh. l. c. <he>ומַחְדֵּי</he>).

senses.gloss: to observe a festival, v. חֶדְוָה. Y. M. Kat. II, 81ᵇ top מְחַדֵּי את מועדא וכ׳ wouldst thou enjoy the festival? Drink &c.
